title: Samples from the Baltic Sea anomaly test as burned organic material

tellings.quote: when we did the samples there from uh uh we take from not from the object, but from that laying on the object. Uh it was organic burned natural.

plain: In 2011 and 2012, divers took samples from the material lying on top of a strange round shape on the floor of the Baltic Sea, and the tests showed it was burned organic matter of natural origin. Dennis Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter whose team found the shape, tells Michels this himself and notes the samples were not taken from the object itself. The burned material matters because it would suggest something very hot once happened there.
